newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh PM hands islanders navy-built shelters.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh PM hands islanders navy-built shelters.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Wednesday handed over a navy-built shelter to people in the Saint Martin's island who had been made homeless by a cyclone last month.
The shelter to house 10 families was the first of many more being constructed by the Bangladesh navy on the storm-ravaged island in the Bay of Bengal.
"The government is doing everything possible for you. This is just one of many shelters we will build for you," Hasina told the cheering islanders.
The cyclone on May 19 killed more than 100 people along the coast and left more than a million homeless in one of the world's poorest countries.
The prime minister flew to the island off Bangladesh's southeastern tip of Teknaf by an air force helicopter.
On way back to Dhaka she also briefly landed at Anwara, near the Chittagong port, to see the rehabilitation of the cyclone-hit people there.
